source_columns: child_hispanic, child_race_1, child_race_2, child_race_3, child_race_4, child_race_5, child_race_6, child_race_other
expression:
local({
  white <- as.numeric(child_race_1) == 1
  black <- as.numeric(child_race_2) == 1
  asian <- as.numeric(child_race_3) == 1
  aian <- as.numeric(child_race_4) == 1
  nhpi <- as.numeric(child_race_5) == 1
  other <- as.numeric(child_race_6) == 1
  n_races <- white + black + asian + aian + nhpi + other
  ethnicity <- coalesce(
    lookup_values(
      case_when(
        as.numeric(child_hispanic) == 1 ~ "Hispanic origin, any race",
        n_races >= 2 ~ "Non-Hispanic, two or more races",
        white ~ "Non-Hispanic, White alone",
        black ~ "Non-Hispanic, Black or African American alone",
        asian ~ "Non-Hispanic, Asian or Asian American alone",
        aian ~ "Non-Hispanic, Native American or Alaskan native alone",
        nhpi ~ "Non-Hispanic, Native Hawaiian or other Pacific Islander alone",
        .default = NA_character_
      ),
      lookup_ethnicity,
      dataset_id = spec$dataset_id,
      target_variable = "ethnicity"
    ),
    if_else(other, lookup_values(trimws(child_race_other), lookup_ethnicity_other, default = "Unknown"), NA_character_),
    "Unknown"
  )
  ethnicity
})
notes: Parent report of the child: Hispanic origin (child_hispanic, 'Is your child of Hispanic, Mexican, or Latin American ethnicity?') first, then the multi-select race items: one race = that race alone, two or more = Mixed. Non-Hispanic 'Other' alone (19 rows) is resolved from child_race_other through ethnicity_other: mixed answers = Mixed, Middle Eastern = Other, bare nationalities, 'human' and religion = Unknown. Shared lookup. Proximate: Native American or Alaskan native and Native Hawaiian or Pacific Islander alone fold into Other. At 11-17 the parent may have described a sibling in multi-child families (26 dyads' ages differ by more than a year). The parent's own hisp_acs, race_acs_1 to race_acs_6 and race are unused.
